brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
wait @buildthis.bisks.net can we have an atproto viewer styled like its a linux project mailing list? So all the replies show up as emails in the body but then there’s also the back forward parent navigation etc., etc.

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@ayourtch.bsky.social: My pet basilisk told me Bsky allows your own appviews
  [image, alt text: A very ugly looking appview]

[from the harness, not the requester] 1 image from this thread is attached to this build as a file — you can see it. If someone asks whether you can see their screenshot, the answer is yes.

[from the harness, not the requester] These images were in the thread but could
NOT be downloaded, so you do NOT have them. Don't describe or guess at their
contents. If they matter to the request, say in your reply that you couldn't
fetch them and ask for a description.
- https://cdn.bsky.app/img/feed_fullsize/plain/did:plc:6647tx44spwppvqz65t3kagy/bafkreihdfx5xmp6ixm56gqikju4gxjph3snlhwbtva6z4bhps3kgbab7ou (came back as , not an image)
note: lorebsky: paste any Bluesky post and its thread becomes a lore.kernel.org-style list — replies as emails with headers + quoted parents, parent/prev/next nav, overview tree.
